description: Send durable mail to running sessions selected by selector.

all_namespaces.description: Bypass namespace scoping and match across all namespaces.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client idempotency key scoped to the derived sender.

intent.description: Message intent tag. Receipt is reserved for daemon system messages.

namespace.description: Namespace slug to scope this tool. Overrides the caller session namespace fallback.

notify.description: Wake mode after mail is persisted: wait (until the recipient is idle) or steer (interrupt, then deliver); defaults to wait.

to.description:
Recipient selector used for matching running sessions.

Grammar:
  all
  <uuid>
  id:<uuid>
  role:<name>
  namespace:<slug>
  dir:<path>
  label:<key>=<value>
  label:<key> in (v1, v2)
Examples:
  all
  019e44f9-...
  role:engineer
  namespace:default
  dir:/tmp/project
  label:app=nginx
  "label:app in (web, api)"

name: mail_send
